episode_title: Hope in Hard Places: Jabee Williams on OKC, Violence, and Hope

You know, a lot of the, you know, organizations. And then, you know, I have my own organizations. I have Live Free Oklahoma and Love OKC.

We also, you know, curate and put on several art shows throughout the year. We just had one, Women of Color, last weekend that was really good.
We also do the Juneteenth Festival, Juneteenth on the East every year. We do a program with my community where we mentor students at Emerson, North Emerson South, also with the Star Foundation.
And I'm about to start a program over at the Berry House as well, where we're teaching the kids their creative pathways.
